baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rootless focus consists only of the two graphemes ي and س, performed as letter names rather than as a rooted lexical item.
baseline_models.mechanism: Segmentation into named letters makes the ayah both an acoustic event and a graphic onset; its first recoverable function is to initiate attention while withholding a lexical proposition.

changed_reading.before: An opaque token awaiting a lexical gloss.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately voiced pair of letter-signs whose event of onset matters even while lexical content remains suspended.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: No rooted morpheme or ordinary clause relation is available inside يسٓ; only juxtaposition and sequence are visible.
baseline_models.mechanism: The absence of normal parsing creates a threshold between perceiving a sign and possessing its explanation, making semantic delay part of the construction.

changed_reading.before: A blank prefatory marker outside the discourse.
changed_reading.after: A threshold that makes the reader experience visibility and audibility before intelligibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first recited letter-name, yā, acoustically coincides with the Arabic vocative particle, while the following sīn remains unresolved.
baseline_models.mechanism: That sound overlap permits a focus-only call-form hypothesis without assigning the second letter a lexical identity: an address may be sounded while its addressee is withheld.

changed_reading.after: Possibly an unresolved summons, though the focus alone cannot distinguish call from coincidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah immediately moves from bare letter-sounds into recitation, sending, and message-delivery, then later distinguishes its discourse from poetry. This turns the opening from material outside the message into the message's smallest performed threshold.

activation_trace.role: Reading and recitation identify the adjacent discourse as performed text and make the focus letter-names its first audible units.
Messenger and message supply a transmission relation in which the opening can function as the first received signal.
Delivering a message supplies the endpoint-oriented communicative mechanism that turns onset into transmission.
The poetry branch supplies the explicitly excluded performance mode, sharpening the opening as purposeful recitation rather than ornamental verse.
The late return to recitation closes the whole-surah frame and keeps the opening inside the performed Qur'anic act.

structural_cues: 36:2-5 proceeds from the two letters to Qur'an, messenger, straight path, and descent without an intervening lexical gloss.
36:69 returns to reminder and clear Qur'an while explicitly denying poetry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, sending, delivery, and a contrastive performance category; I infer that the rootless onset stages signal before exposition. A live alternative is that it is an independent name or authority marker rather than a transmission threshold.

changed_reading.before: An opaque preface external to the communicated message.
changed_reading.after: The first micro-event of transmission: letter-sounds are received before the message is propositionally unfolded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing joins discrete elements, traces preserve absent acts, counting exhausts the record, and the clear imam orders it. Together they activate the two opening graphemes as a minimal inscription whose small visible inventory can carry more than it presently discloses.

activation_trace.role: Ordering letters into writing supplies the literal graphic mechanism and recasts يسٓ as an inscription rather than sound alone.
A remaining mark that points back to what occurred makes the opening graphemes legible as durable traces with deferred explanation.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies a discrete-unit logic in which even two isolated signs belong to an accounted whole.
The guiding imam supplies an ordered register or reference frame in which otherwise isolated marks can be followed.

structural_cues: 36:12 binds reviving the dead, writing prior acts, preserving traces, exhaustive counting, and a clear imam in one sentence.
The focus itself is visually countable as two signs despite lacking rooted morphology.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, surviving marks, enumeration, and an ordering guide; I infer that the opening foregrounds elemental written units whose interpretive value can be deferred. A live alternative is that the letters only mark oral performance and do not model the register.

changed_reading.before: A purely acoustic pair of unexplained names.
changed_reading.after: Also a compact written trace that trains attention to inscription, preservation, and deferred reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly presents signs while staging barriers to reception: paths are blocked, sight fails, and mouths are sealed. The focus's visible and audible but unparsable form makes the reader briefly undergo that same separation between sign-presence and access.

activation_trace.role: Closing gaps and barring passage supplies the spatial model for signs that are present yet inaccessible from both directions.
Literal eyesight supplies the failed receptive channel, turning the opening's visibility without explanation into enacted non-seeing.
A securing seal supplies blocked ordinary speech, paralleling the opening's refusal to yield normal lexical discourse.

structural_cues: 36:8-10 combines bodily restraint, barriers before and behind, covering, failed sight, and failed warning.
36:46 says signs keep arriving while their recipients turn away.
36:65-66 seals mouths and imagines erased sight, shifting or removing normal channels of disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical and perceptual obstructions around otherwise available signs; I infer that the opening's suspended parse makes blockage experiential. A live alternative is that opacity marks identity or authority without modeling failed reception.

changed_reading.after: A performative test of reception: the sign is fully present while ordinary access to its meaning is barred.

context_deltas.mechanism: Major transitions in the surah occur through voiced or breathed events: one cry extinguishes or gathers, a blast releases the graves, displaced speech testifies, and saying is followed by being. This makes the opening's nonlexical vocality potentially operative rather than merely decorative.

activation_trace.role: A terrifying cry supplies a single sonic event that changes an entire population's state.
Sending breath into an instrument supplies the physical production of a sound that initiates emergence.
The blown horn supplies the resonant medium by which breath becomes a collective summons.
Intelligible speech that connects speakers supplies communicative force even after its normal bodily source is displaced.
Uttered saying supplies the vocal action immediately preceding a change in being.
Coming into occurrence supplies the resulting state and makes the preceding utterance functionally consequential.

structural_cues: 36:29, 36:49, and 36:53 repeat the pattern of one cry followed by an immediate state transition.
36:51 moves from a blast to rapid emergence from graves.
36:65 relocates speech from sealed mouths to hands, and 36:82 places saying directly before being.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decisive cries, blown breath, displaced speech, and saying followed by occurrence; I infer that 36:1 preloads sound itself as an event before lexical exposition. A live alternative is that the letter-names are only a formal recitation boundary.

changed_reading.before: Sounds that remain inert until a later sentence gives meaning.
changed_reading.after: A tiny voiced onset that anticipates a surah in which sounding can itself mark or cause a change of state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated direct addresses, commands to hear, and scenes of calling retrospectively activate the first letter-name's yā sound as a vocative cue. The second letter remains deliberately unexpanded, so the model is a call-form rather than a decoded name.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech introduces a direct yā-address and supplies the concrete call side of a call-response mechanism.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the requested response to an address.
Calling or inclining by speech supplies the broader verbal summons that keeps the opening's vocative possibility live.

structural_cues: Explicit yā-vocatives recur at 36:20, 36:30, 36:52, and 36:60 with different addressees and affects.
36:25 ends a confession with an imperative to hear, giving address a demanded response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated yā-addresses, utterance, hearing, and calling; I infer that their recurrence retrospectively charges the first letter-name's matching sound. A live alternative is simple phonetic coincidence, and no packet evidence identifies sīn as an addressee.

changed_reading.before: A pair of letter names with no interpersonal direction.
changed_reading.after: An unresolved summons whose call is audible but whose receiver or completion is not lexicalized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus contains exactly two differentiated signs. The surah's pairing language, coordinated cosmic oppositions, and final speech-to-being sequence activate that dyad as a minimal relational unit: difference is preserved, but the two signs operate together.

activation_trace.role: A counterpart joined to its counterpart supplies the relational pattern for reading the two opening signs together without collapsing their difference.
Occurrence following a compact utterance supplies a generative horizon in which a minimal sign-pair can precede an expanded world of discourse.

structural_cues: 36:36 universalizes pairs across earth, selves, and what is not known.
36:37-40 coordinates night and day and sun and moon as differentiated partners whose ordered paths do not collapse into one another.
The focus is a stable two-part sequence rather than a repeated single sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joined counterparts, coordinated cosmic pairs, and compact speech followed by occurrence; I infer that the two-sign onset can model relation before proposition. A live alternative is that the count of two has no thematic force and the pairing is accidental.

changed_reading.before: Two arbitrary fragments placed side by side.
changed_reading.after: A minimal pair whose joining and preserved difference anticipate the surah's relational ordering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps the count of opening graphemes onto a later narrative count. It remains anchored in the focus's exactly two segments and the packet's explicit two-strengthened-by-third sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a formal resonance, never as a claim that either letter names a messenger or predicts a hidden third letter.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يسٓ presents two discrete letter-signs before the surah narrates an explicitly counted pair that receives a third reinforcement.

activation_trace.role: Joining one to one to make two supplies the exact count that resonates with the focus's two visible units.
Reinforcement supplies the directional move by which an initial pair receives added support.
A completing third supplies the new term that strengthens rather than erases the prior pair.

changed_reading.before: A self-contained dyad with no sequential pressure.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, an initial pair awaiting reinforcement by the articulated discourse that follows.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This crosses from morphology-less letters to an efficacious creation command, so it is branch-distant. It remains anchored to the focus as a compact pronounceable sign-sequence and to 36:82 as compact speech immediately realized; downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy of form and efficacy, not a lexical decoding of يسٓ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus is an extremely compact pronounceable sequence whose operation precedes any supplied paraphrase.

activation_trace.role: Authoritative command supplies the operative instruction frame for a very compact utterance.
A thing's saying as its indication supplies a sign-function broader than ordinary descriptive speech.
Immediate occurrence supplies the effect side of the analogy between a compact sign and enacted result.

changed_reading.before: An uninterpretable fragment that can do nothing until decoded.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a code-like sign whose performative force may precede semantic exposition.

strongest_changes: The rootless opening moved from an external enigma to the smallest performed threshold of recitation and transmission.
Writing, traces, and enumeration made the same two units legible as a compact inscription with deferred disclosure.
Barriers, failed sight, and sealing made opacity functional: the reader experiences a present sign without ordinary access.
Repeated cries, blasts, speech, and command made the letter-names audible as a potentially operative sound-event.
summary.what_was_special: Because 36:1 has no rooted morphemes or branch inventory, every viable activation had to return to the construction itself: two countable, visible, pronounceable signs. Whole-surah context made their acoustic, graphic, receptive, relational, and performative properties more informative without supplying a lexical gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: All retained changes are constructional rather than lexical because the focus supplies no rooted anchor.
The vocative yā resonance may be intentional call-form or only phonetic coincidence.
Pair-count, two-plus-third, and compact-command analogies remain exploratory and should not be converted into letter-by-letter decoding.
